unit: standalone passage matching a selected human passage; not an entire source book or paper
pilot_rule: Quarantined input is allowed only with explicit --pilot; every output remains quarantined and training_eligible=false. Pilot is development-exposed and cannot become locked test.
split_inheritance: Every mirror inherits its original document family and frozen partition. Never split generated rows independently.
generator_diversity: Single-model pilot only until a model mixture is selected; no claim of reproducing Pangram's undisclosed generator weights.
